name: Om Vanwari
description:
**Om Vanwari** is a Computer Science and Engineering student and an open-source software developer and contributor at **FOSSASIA**. He is a **Google Summer of Code 2026 Contributor**, where he has worked across the Eventyay ecosystem on projects involving CRM integration and video processing.

His current work focuses on **VEditor**, a standalone video review and transcoding pipeline built with FastAPI, RQ, PyAV, and PostgreSQL, designed to streamline the processing and review of conference recordings. Previously, he built and shipped **eventyay-hubspot**, integrating HubSpot CRM with Eventyay for automated contact and event synchronization.

Om's interests lie in **backend architecture, media processing, open-source software, and developer tooling**. He enjoys working on systems that turn complex workflows into reliable, automated tools and actively contributes to open-source projects through development, architectural improvements, and collaboration with the wider community.
